skills.description_it: Rende bloccabili attacchi che prima non lo erano.
skills.description_zh: 可以格挡各种一般无法格挡的攻击。

skills.name: Knockout King

skills.description_de: Erleichtert die Betäubung von Monstern.

skills.name: Partbreaker

skills.description_fr: Vous brisez ou coupez plus facilement les parties faibles des monstres.
skills.description_es: Hace más fácil romper o cortar partes de monstruos.
skills.description_it: Rende più facile ferire, rompere o tagliare parti dei mostri.
skills.description_zh: 更容易破坏怪物的部位。

skills.description: Greatly increases Attack and Defense when Health is below 40% of the maximum amount.
skills.description_de: Angriff und Verteidigung steigen stark, wenn die Gesundheit unter 40% des Maximalwertes sinkt.
skills.description_fr: Augmente grandement l'attaque et la défense quand la vie est inférieure à 40 % du maximum.
skills.description_es: Aumenta mucho ataque y defensa cuando la salud esté por debajo del 40% de su cantidad máxima.
skills.description_it: Aumenta molto attacco e difesa quando la vita è al di sotto del 40%.
skills.description_zh: 当体力降低到上限40%以下时，防御力和攻击力大幅提升。

skills.name: Adrenaline +1
skills.description: Greatly increases Defense when Health is below 40% of the maximum amount.
skills.description_de: Verteidigung steigt stark, wenn die Gesundheit unter 40% des Maximalwertes sinkt.
skills.description_fr: Augmente grandement la défense quand la vie est inférieure à 40 % du maximum.
skills.description_es: Aumenta mucho la defensa cuando la salud está por debajo del 40% de su cantidad máxima.
skills.description_it: Aumenta molto la difesa se la barra vita è al di sotto del 40%.
skills.description_zh: 当体力降低到上限40%以下时，防御力大幅提升。

skills.name: Worrywart
skills.description: Decreases Defense boost and Attack when Health is below 40% of maximum.
skills.description_de: Senkt Verteidigungsboost und Angriff, wenn Gesundheit unter 40 % des Maximums fällt.
skills.description_fr: Réduit le bonus de défense et l'attaque quand la vie est inférieure à 40 % du maximum.
skills.description_es: Reduce potenciador defensa y ataque cuando la salud está por debajo del 40% del máximo.
skills.description_it: Riduce l'incremento di difesa e l'attacco quando la barra vita si riduce a meno del 40%.
skills.description_zh: 当体力降低到上限40%以下时，防御力提升的效果降低，攻击力也会降低。

skills.name: Fortify
skills.description: Increases your Attack and Defense every time you fall in battle.
skills.description_de: Steigert deinen Angriff und deine Verteidigung jedes Mal, wenn du im Kampf fällst.
skills.description_fr: Augmente l'attaque et la défense chaque fois que vous tombez au combat.
skills.description_es: Aumenta tu ataque y defensa cada vez que caes en combate.
skills.description_it: Aumenta l'attacco e difesa quando cadi in battaglia.
skills.description_zh: 每次力尽倒地后攻击力和防御力都会提升。

skills.name: Resentment
skills.description: Increases Attack when your Health Gauge is in the red.
skills.description_de: Steigert Angriff, wenn dein Gesundheitsbalken im roten Bereich ist.
skills.description_fr: Augmente l'attaque lorsque la jauge de vie est dans le rouge.
skills.description_es: Aumenta el ataque cuando el indicador de salud está en rojo.
skills.description_it: Aumenta l'attacco quando la barra vita è in rosso.
skills.description_zh: 体力槽出现红色槽时攻击力会提升。

skills.name: Resuscitate
skills.description: Increases Attack when you are suffering from abnormal status.
skills.description_de: Steigert Angriff, wenn du einen anormalen Status erleidest.
skills.description_fr: Augmente l'attaque lorsque vous êtes victime d'une affliction.
skills.description_es: Aumenta el ataque cuando sufres un efecto anormal.
skills.description_it: Aumenta l'attacco quando subisci gli effetti di status alterati.
skills.description_zh: 身处异常状态时攻击力会提升。

skills.name: Guts
skills.description: Prevents fainting a single time if struck with a lethal blow when a certain amount of Health remains.
skills.description_de: Verhindert einmal Ohnmacht bei tödlichem Schlag, wenn ein gewisser Betrag Gesundheit übrig ist.
skills.description_fr: Évite un seul évanouissement si vous subissez un coup fatal et qu'il vous reste un certain montant de vie.
skills.description_es: Evita desmayarte una vez al recibir un golpe mortal si tienes cierta cantidad de salud.
skills.description_it: Previene uno svenimento se colpito da un colpo letale quando resta una certa quantità di vita.
skills.description_zh: 当体力高于一定水平时，即使受到超量伤害也不会力尽倒地。

skills.name: Sneak
skills.description: Decreases the likelihood of being targeted by monsters.
skills.description_de: Verringert die Wahrscheinlichkeit, zum Ziel von Monstern zu werden.
skills.description_fr: Réduit la probabilité d'être pris pour cible par les monstres.
skills.description_es: Reduce la probabilidad de ser atacado por monstruos.
skills.description_it: Riduce la probabilità di essere individuati dai mostri.
skills.description_zh: 不容易成为怪物的目标。

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Increases the likelihood of being targeted by monsters.
skills.description_de: Vergrößert die Wahrscheinlichkeit, zum Ziel von Monstern zu werden.
skills.description_fr: Augmente la probabilité d'être repéré par les monstres.
skills.description_es: Aumenta la probabilidad de ser atacado por monstruos.
skills.description_it: Aumenta la probabilità di essere individuati dai mostri.
skills.description_zh: 容易成为怪物的目标。

skills.name: Palico Rally
skills.description: Increases the Attack and Defense of Palicoes.
skills.description_de: Erhöht den Angriff und die Verteidigung von Kameraden.
skills.description_fr: Augmente l'attaque et la défense des Palicos.
skills.description_es: Aumenta el ataque y la defensa de los camaradas.
skills.description_it: Aumenta l'attacco e la difesa dei compagni.
skills.description_zh: 随从的攻击力和防御力提升。

skills.name: Palico Cheer
skills.description: Allows "Fist Pump" gesture to call back fainted/recovering Palicoes. Cannot be used repeatedly.
skills.description_de: Ermöglicht, ohnmächtige / erholende Kameraden mit "Siegerfaust"-Geste zurückzurufen. Nicht wiederholbar.
skills.description_fr: L'émote "Victoire !" rappelle les Palicos évanouis ou en récupération. Usage limité.
skills.description_es: "Puño en alto" llama a camaradas desmayados o en recuperación. No se puede usar repetidamente.
skills.description_it: Richiama con il gesto Vittoria compagni svenuti o in recupero. Non permette l'uso ripetuto.
skills.description_zh: 使用动作“呼喊”后随从会完全回复，撤退中的随从也会马上出战。不能连续使用。

skills.name: Mounting Master
skills.description: Makes it easier to mount and successfully topple a monster.
skills.description_de: Erleichtert es, auf ein Monster aufzusteigen und es zu Fall zu bringen.
skills.description_fr: Chevaucher un monstre et le renverser devient plus facile.
skills.description_es: Facilita permanecer montado en un monstruo hasta derribarlo.
skills.description_it: Rende più facile salire e restare in groppa ai mostri.
skills.description_zh: 更容易骑乘怪物，骑乘时更容易成功。

skills.name: Saddle Sore
skills.description: Makes it harder to mount and successfully topple a monster.
skills.description_de: Erschwert es, auf ein Monster aufzusteigen und es zu Fall zu bringen.
skills.description_fr: Chevaucher un monstre et le renverser devient plus difficile.
skills.description_es: Dificulta permanecer montado en un monstruo hasta derribarlo.
skills.description_it: Rende più difficile salire e restare in groppa ai mostri.
skills.description_zh: 更难骑乘怪物，骑乘时更难成功。

skills.name: Airborne
skills.description: Increases the damage caused by Jumping Attacks.
skills.description_de: Steigert Schaden durch Sprungangriffe.
skills.description_fr: Augmente les dégâts infligés par les attaques sautées.
skills.description_es: Aumenta el daño de los ataques en salto.
skills.description_it: Aumenta i danni inflitti dagli attacchi in salto.
skills.description_zh: 强化跳跃攻击。

skills.name: Composed
skills.description: Makes it easier to fill the Arts Gauge, Valor Gauge, and Alchemy Gauge.
skills.description_de: Erleichtert dir das Füllen von Technikbalken, Wagemutbalken und Alchemiebalken.
skills.description_fr: Accélère le remplissage de la jauge d'arts, de la jauge de vaillance et de la jauge d'alchimie.
skills.description_es: Facilita llenar el indicador de técnicas, el indicador de valor y el indicador de alquimia.
skills.description_it: Accelera la ricarica della barra delle arti, della barra del valore e della barra alchemica.
skills.description_zh: 更容易积攒狩技槽、英勇槽和炼金槽。

skills.name: Chance Seizer
skills.description: Fills the Arts Gauge, Valor Gauge and Alchemy Gauge when damage is received.
skills.description_de: Füllt Technikbalken, Wagemutbalken und Alchemiebalken, wenn du Schaden nimmst.
skills.description_fr: Remplit la jauge d'arts, la jauge de vaillance et la jauge d'alchimie lorsque vous recevez des dégâts.
skills.description_es: Rellena el indicador de técnicas, el indicador de valor y el indicador de alquimia cuando recibes daño.
skills.description_it: Fa ricaricare la barra delle arti, la barra del valore e la barra alchemica quando subisci dei danni dai mostri.
skills.description_zh: 受到怪物的伤害时也能积攒狩技槽、英勇槽和炼金槽。

skills.name: Longer SP
skills.description: Extends the effect time of the SP State triggered by SP Hunter Arts.
skills.description_de: Verlängert die Wirkung des durch SP-Jagdtechniken ausgelösten SP-Zustands.
skills.description_fr: L'état SP déclenché par les arts de chasse SP dure plus longtemps.
skills.description_es: Alarga el tiempo del efecto SP iniciado por técnicas de caza SP.
skills.description_it: Prolunga gli status SP attivati con le arti di caccia SP.
skills.description_zh: 发动SP狩技进入SP状态时持续时间更长。

skills.name: Autotracker
skills.description: Large monsters always display on the Map, as if they were marked.
skills.description_de: Große Monster werden immer wie markiert auf der Karte angezeigt.
skills.description_fr: Affiche toujours les grands monstres sur la carte, comme s'ils portaient un marqueur.
skills.description_es: Los monstruos grandes siempre aparecen en el mapa, como si estuviesen marcados.
skills.description_it: I mostri grandi compariranno sempre sulla mappa, come se fossero stati segnati.
skills.description_zh: 大型怪物会以被染色弹命中的状态在地图上标记出来。

skills.name: Detect
skills.description: Increases the information displayed on the Map when large monsters are marked.
skills.description_de: Zeigt mehr Informationen auf der Karte, wenn große Monster markiert sind.
skills.description_fr: Augmente les infos affichées sur la carte quand de grands monstres sont marqués.
skills.description_es: Aumenta la información en el mapa cuando hay monstruos grandes marcados.
skills.description_it: Aumenta le informazioni mostrate sulla mappa quando segni mostri grandi.
skills.description_zh: 大型怪物被染色时在地图上会显示更多信息。

skills.name: Capture Guru
skills.description: Grants knowledge of when a large monster can be captured.
skills.description_de: Verleiht Wissen über den Zeit- punkt, an dem ein großes Monster gefangen werden kann.
skills.description_fr: Indique quand un grand monstre peut être capturé.
skills.description_es: Aporta conocimiento sobre cuándo se puede capturar a un monstruo grande.
skills.description_it: Ti permette di sapere quando puoi catturare un mostro grande.
skills.description_zh: 可以看见能捕获大型怪物的提示。

skills.name: Outdoorsman
skills.description: Always shows the Map, even if you don't have one. Easier to fish and BBQ meat.
skills.description_de: Zeigt immer die Karte, auch wenn man keine hat. Praktisch beim Angeln und Grillen.
skills.description_fr: Affiche la carte en permanence. Facilite la pêche et la cuisson au barbecue.
skills.description_es: Muestra el mapa siempre, hasta cuando no tienes. Así es más fácil pescar y cocinar.
skills.description_it: Mostra la mappa, anche se non la possiedi. Rende più semplice la pesca e il barbecue.
skills.description_zh: 在任务中的钓鱼和烤肉都得心应手，即使不携带地图道具也能看到地图。

skills.name: Pro Transporter
skills.description: Increases your speed while transporting items and decreases the likelihood of dropping them.
skills.description_de: Erhöht die Geschwindigkeit bei Transport von Gegenständen und senkt Gefahr von Fallenlassen.
skills.description_fr: Augmente la vitesse lors du transport d'objets et réduit le risque de les lâcher.
skills.description_es: Mejora la velocidad al transportar objetos y reduce la probabilidad de que se te caigan.
skills.description_it: Rende più veloci quando si trasportano oggetti e riduce la probabilità di perderli.
skills.description_zh: 搬运时的移动速度增加，即使从相当的高度跳落也不会让搬运物摔坏。

skills.name: Divine Blessing
skills.description: Sometimes decreases damage taken.
skills.description_de: Verringert manchmal erlittenen Schaden.
skills.description_fr: Diminue parfois les dégâts subis.
skills.description_es: A veces reduce el daño recibido.
skills.description_it: A volte riduce i danni subiti.
skills.description_zh: 一定概率减少玩家所受的伤害。

skills.name: Demonic Blessing
skills.description: Sometimes increases damage taken.
skills.description_de: Erhöht manchmal den erlittenen Schaden.
skills.description_fr: Augmente parfois les dégâts subis.
skills.description_es: A veces aumenta el daño recibido.
skills.description_it: A volte aumenta i danni subiti.
skills.description_zh: 一定概率增加玩家所受的伤害。

skills.name: Hero's Talisman
skills.description: Negates the damage from minor enemy attacks.
skills.description_de: Hebt den Schaden von kleineren feindlichen Angriffen auf.
skills.description_fr: Annule les dégâts des attaques ennemies mineures.
skills.description_es: Anula el daño de ataques menores del enemigo.
skills.description_it: Annulla i danni causati dagli attacchi nemici minori.
skills.description_zh: 免疫所有轻微的伤害。

skills.name: Recovery Up
skills.description: Increases the amount recovered when recovering Health.
skills.description_de: Steigert die Heilung während der Erholung.
skills.description_fr: Augmente les effets de la récupération de vie.
skills.description_es: Aumenta la cantidad recuperada al recuperar salud.
skills.description_it: Aumenta la quantità di punti vita recuperati.
skills.description_zh: 增加体力回复时的回复量。

skills.name: Recovery Down
skills.description: Decreases the amount recovered when recovering Health.
skills.description_de: Senkt die Heilung während der Erholung.
skills.description_fr: Réduit les effets de la récupération de vie.
skills.description_es: Reduce la cantidad recuperada al recuperar salud.
skills.description_it: Riduce la quantità di punti vita recuperati.
skills.description_zh: 降低体力回复时的回复量。

skills.name: Recovery Spd +2
skills.description: Greatly speeds recovery from temporary damage (the red portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.description_de: Viel schnellere Erholung von zeitweiligem Schaden (rot im Gesundheitsbalken).
skills.description_fr: Récupération bien plus rapide des dégâts temporaires (zone rouge de la jauge de vie).
skills.description_es: Acelera mucho la recuperación del daño temporal (parte roja del indicador de salud).
skills.description_it: Accelera molto il recupero dai danni temporanei (parte rossa della barra vita).
skills.description_zh: 受到伤害后，红色槽的回复速度大幅度提高。

skills.name: Recovery Spd +1
skills.description: Speeds recovery from temporary damage (the red portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.description_de: Bietet schnellere Erholung von zeitweiligem Schaden (rot im Gesundheitsbalken).
skills.description_fr: Récupération plus rapide des dégâts temporaires (zone rouge de la jauge de vie).
skills.description_es: Acelera la recuperación del daño temporal (parte roja del indicador de salud).
skills.description_it: Accelera il recupero dai danni temporanei (parte rossa della barra vita).
skills.description_zh: 受到伤害后，红色槽的回复速度提高。

skills.name: Recovery Spd -1
skills.description: Slows recovery from temporary damage (the red portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.description_de: Langsamere Erholung von zeitweiligem Schaden (rot im Gesundheitsbalken).
skills.description_fr: Récupération moins rapide des dégâts temporaires (zone rouge de la jauge de vie).
skills.description_es: Frena la recuperación del daño temporal (parte roja del indicador de salud).
skills.description_it: Rallenta il recupero dai danni temporanei (parte rossa della barra vita).
skills.description_zh: 受到伤害后，红色槽的回复速度降低。

skills.name: Recovery Spd -2
skills.description: Greatly slows recovery from temporary damage (the red portion of the Health Gauge).
skills.description_de: Viel langsamere Erholung von zeitweiligem Schaden (rot im Gesundheitsbalken).
skills.description_fr: Récupération bien moins rapide des dégâts temporaires (zone rouge de la jauge de vie).
skills.description_es: Frena mucho la recuperación del daño temporal (parte roja del indicador de salud).
skills.description_it: Rallenta molto il recupero dai danni temporanei (parte rossa della barra vita).
skills.description_zh: 受到伤害后，红色槽的回复速度大幅度降低。

skills.name: Item Use Up
skills.description: Increases the effect time of certain items.
skills.description_de: Verlängert die Wirkungszeit bestimmter Objekte.
skills.description_fr: Augmente la durée d'effet de certains objets.
skills.description_es: Aumenta el tiempo de efecto de ciertos objetos.
skills.description_it: Aumenta la durata degli effetti di alcuni oggetti.
skills.description_zh: 部分道具的有效时间延长。

skills.name: Item Use Down
skills.description: Decreases the effect time of certain items.
skills.description_de: Verkürzt die Wirkungszeit bestimmter Objekte.
skills.description_fr: Réduit la durée d'effet de certains objets.
skills.description_es: Reduce el tiempo de efecto de ciertos objetos.
skills.description_it: Riduce la durata degli effetti di alcuni oggetti.
skills.description_zh: 部分道具的有效时间缩短。

skills.name: Wide-Range +2
skills.description: Transfers the effects of certain items to companions in the same area.
skills.description_de: Überträgt die Wirkung bestimmter Objekte auf Freunde im gleichen Gebiet.
skills.description_fr: Transfère les effets de certains objets aux amis dans la même zone.
skills.description_es: Transfiere los efectos de ciertos objetos a los camaradas en la zona.
skills.description_it: Trasmette gli effetti di alcuni oggetti ai compagni nella stessa area.
skills.description_zh: 部分道具的效果会作用在同区域的同伴身上。

skills.name: Wide-Range +1
skills.description: Transfers a portion of the effects of certain items to companions in the same area.
skills.description_de: Überträgt einen Teil der Wirkung einiger Objekte auf Freunde im gleichen Gebiet.
skills.description_fr: Transfère une part des effets de certains objets aux amis dans la même zone.
skills.description_es: Transfiere parte de los efectos de ciertos objetos a los camaradas en la zona.
skills.description_it: Trasmette parte degli effetti di alcuni oggetti ai compagni nell'area.
skills.description_zh: 部分道具的效果会少量作用在同区域的同伴身上。

skills.name: Negate Hunger
skills.description: Negates maximum Stamina depletion over time.
skills.description_de: Hebt maximalen Ausdauer- verlust über Zeit auf.
skills.description_fr: La stamina maximale ne diminue plus.
skills.description_es: Anula el gasto de resistencia con el tiempo.
skills.description_it: Annulla il consumo della resistenza massima nel corso del tempo.
skills.description_zh: 耐力槽上限不会随着时间减少。

skills.name: Halve Hunger
skills.description: Halves the speed of maximum Stamina depletion over time.
skills.description_de: Halbiert maximalen Ausdauer- verlust über Zeit.
skills.description_fr: La stamina maximale diminue deux fois moins vite.
skills.description_es: Reduce a la mitad el ritmo de gasto máximo de resistencia con el tiempo.
skills.description_it: Dimezza la velocità del consumo della resistenza massima nel corso del tempo.
skills.description_zh: 耐力槽上限随时间减少的速度减半。

skills.name: Raise Hunger
skills.description: Speeds maximum Stamina depletion over time.
skills.description_de: Steigert maximalen Ausdauer- verlust über Zeit.
skills.description_fr: La stamina maximale diminue plus vite.
skills.description_es: Acelera el gasto de resistencia con el tiempo.
skills.description_it: Accelera il consumo della resistenza massima nel corso del tempo.
skills.description_zh: 耐力槽上限随时间减少的速度增加。

skills.name: Double Hunger
skills.description: Greatly speeds up maximum Stamina depletion over time.
skills.description_de: Steigert maximalen Ausdauer- verlust über Zeit stark.
skills.description_fr: La stamina maximale diminue nettement plus vite.
skills.description_es: Acelera mucho el gasto de resistencia con el tiempo.
skills.description_it: Accelera nettamente il consumo della resistenza massima nel corso del tempo.
skills.description_zh: 耐力槽上限随时间减少的速度大幅度增加。

skills.name: Scavenger
skills.description: Gives any item you eat or drink the potential to also raise your maximum Stamina.
skills.description_de: Verleiht allem, was du isst oder trinkst, das Potenzial, deine maximale Ausdauer zu erhöhen.
skills.description_fr: Tous les objets que vous mangez ou buvez augmentent la jauge de stamina.
skills.description_es: Dota cualquier objeto que comas o bebas de potencia para subir tu resistencia máxima.
skills.description_it: Tutto ciò che mangi o bevi aumenterà anche la tua resistenza massima.
skills.description_zh: 无论吃下什么都能增加耐力槽。

skills.name: Gourmand
skills.description: Increases the efficacy of meat that raises maximum Stamina.
skills.description_de: Erhöht die Wirksamkeit von Fleisch, das die maximale Ausdauer erhöht.
skills.description_fr: Les viandes qui augmentent la jauge de stamina sont plus efficaces.
skills.description_es: Aumenta la eficacia de la carne, que sube la resistencia máxima.
skills.description_it: Aumenta l'efficacia della carne che aumenta la resistenza massima.
skills.description_zh: 提高肉类道具增加耐力槽上限的效果。

skills.name: Speed Eating +2
skills.description: Increases meat-eating and item-consuming speed.
skills.description_de: Erhöht die Geschwindigkeit des Fleisch- und Objektkonsums.
skills.description_fr: Augmente la vitesse de consommation de viande et d'objets.
skills.description_es: Aumenta la velocidad de consumo de carne y objetos.
skills.description_it: Aumenta la velocità con cui mangi carne e consumi oggetti.
skills.description_zh: 食用肉和各类道具的速度更快。

skills.name: Speed Eating +1
skills.description: Increases meat-eating speed.
skills.description_de: Erhöht die Geschwindigkeit beim Fleischessen.
skills.description_fr: Augmente la vitesse de consommation de viande.
skills.description_es: Aumenta la velocidad de consumo de carne.
skills.description_it: Aumenta la velocità con cui mangi carne.
skills.description_zh: 食用肉的速度更快。

skills.name: Slow Eater
skills.description: Decreases meat-eating speed.
skills.description_de: Verlangsamt das Fleischessen.
skills.description_fr: Réduit la vitesse de consommation de viande.
skills.description_es: Reduce la velocidad de consumo de carne.
skills.description_it: Riduce la velocità con cui mangi carne.
skills.description_zh: 食用肉的速度更慢。

skills.name: Rationer
